descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S22 Handoff sheet, Send dialog and Handoffs screens pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane on the local stack

When Run axe on /rounding/handoff, /snf/handoff, the Send dialog open (editor and recipient list), /handoffs and a /handoffs/<id> detail

Then No serious or critical violations; the handoff text box has a label; Send, Copy and recipient rows have accessible names; the dialog is announced as a dialog

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core results in the visual lane: zero serious or critical

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
